name: sticko-audio-bot
description: Centralized Termux WhatsApp Audio Sticker Bot & HTTP Bridge for Sticko APK (Pairing Code Only)

scripts.clean-sessions: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { const dir = './auth_session'; if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return; let n = 0; for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)) { if (f.startsWith('session-') || f.startsWith('sender-key-')) { fs.rmSync(dir + '/' + f, { force: true }); n++; } } console.log('🧹 Berhasil menghapus ' + n + ' file sesi Signal lama (login creds.json tetap aman!).'); })"
